$note: Architect profile for RepoYeti. Run from the Connections checkout: ARCHITECT_NO_SELF_UPDATE=1 bun <Connections>/packages/connections-arkitect/bin/arkitect.mjs --root . --corpus <Connections>/.arkitect/your-checks --all.
